teaching-result.json.fixture: NEW isolated peaceful platform; seven original bodies. Child/control start with actual FIRST_WORDS from the founding plains dialect, no roots or formation. Main child is kept physically stationary by declared NoAI, not by ongoing setters. Walled unexposed child gets no lesson. Separate AI-enabled adult/baby pair runs the ordinary controller and learns bread autonomously. No post-setup body/lexicon/grammar/inventory setters. Two-observation rule checkpoint stops before mastery; resumed native run must generalize a held-out stone-sword form. Fixed authored material/tool categories, controlled attention, no natural cultural-emergence or scaling claim.

voice-result.json.fixture: NEW normal-difficulty isolated platform; two original stationary NoAI adults, one villager and one pillager, each actually holding one bread. Separate species founding languages with two explicitly seeded foreign I/SEE lexical priors and native SVO; acquisition of those core words is not claimed. Four controlled public demonstrations learn the foreign bread label. One reciprocal sound-only imitation per speaker uses actual previously heard words and authored motor substitutions; no intention or vocabulary is copied. Both native default sample playback methods must execute. No semantic/resource grant from parroting. No existing population opened; no client auditory assessment, waveform recognition or natural cross-species diplomacy claimed.

reception-result.json.fixture: NEW peaceful platform with a separate walled comparison chamber. Five original stationary NoAI adults. The listener/control start with native plains SVO and declared prior acquaintance with seven foreign word meanings, but no foreign receptive grammar; those lexical acquisitions are not claimed here. A real existing snowy/frozen/peaks founding vocabulary with distinct cues is selected and reported. A healthy foreign speaker visibly holds bread; a separate same-biome speaker starts with one native injury and a seeded compact OS copula convention; a native peer also visibly holds bread. Controlled public utterance opportunities obey each speaker's 200-tick dialogue budget. The listener hears full OVS, compact OS and native SVO from actual sounds plus public speaker-specific facts. The wall control has the same lexical priors but no visibility/exposure. No post-setup position, health, vocabulary, grammar or inventory setters; one actual interpreted food request causes a conserved production-code handoff. No existing society opened; no natural bilingual emergence, new semantic invention, visual UX or scaling claim.

limitations: Four authored material/tool combinations and finite compound patterns; no new semantic category invention

Native sample grunts render the symbolic word stream with individual pitch/rhythm; not waveform ASR, reversible phonetic synthesis or a client-audition quality result
Imitation begins as sound-only parroting with authored substitutions and bounded motor practice; learned sounds do not grant meanings or translated intent
Shared biome dialects plus individual voice and learned vocabulary; no claim that every individual has an unrelated language

Semantic turns are currently atomic while audio plays on a timed bounded queue; population-scale sound mixing and natural generational survival remain unmeasured
